Ecosystem · Diagram Design

Card payment ecosystem

Four institutions, one payment. The instruction reaches the issuer in under a second; the money follows two days later, and only after the scheme has netted the day's positions.

Two cores carry the story

The payment core owns the authorization attempt and the net settlement block owns the money. Every other block exists to hand one of those two something it needs.

Instruction is not money

The solid muted path is a message; the blue path is funds. They leave at the same moment and arrive days apart, which is why they are drawn as separate flows rather than one arrow.

What the map doesn't show

Failure modes. Declines, chargebacks, and reversals each run their own path back up this map and belong in a second diagram, not as extra arrows on this one.
